summary: Force exchanges and pay in bodies: every death feeds Sacrificial Pyre, Undead Warrior and Ret-Talus, so trade eagerly.
notes: A quiet board is a losing board: aggression creates the deaths this deck converts into value.
Sacrifice is a resource, not a cost: Purge, Elut-Bal and Life Drain are all worth it when they enable a kill or a lane.
Ret-Talus pays 2 damage to recover an Undead unit: use it when the body matters more than the life.
Blood Fury rewards the same exchanges, so keep the Undead Warrior in the fight.
